changeSet.sql: create or replace view ACCOUNTING_ANALYTICS.VW_RECEIPT_DETAIL_REPORT( CONTROL, BATCH, PERIOD, DATE, DATE_YEAR, DATE_MONTH, DATE_DAY, ACCOUNTING_PERIOD, PERSONNAME WITH MASKING POLICY ACCOUNTING_ANALYTICS.NAME_MASK, PERSONCODE, PERSONSTATUS, PROPERTY, PROPERTYCODE, MARKET, OP, DEPOSITNUM, CASHACCT, AMOUNT, REFERENCE, CHECKNUM, NOTES, MODULECREATEDBY, CREATEDBY, CREATEDDATE, MODIFIEDBY, MODIFIEDDATE ) as Select Control, Batch, Period, DATEOCCURED as DATE, Date_Year, Date_Month, Date_Day, CASE WHEN DAY(DATEOCCURED) < 26 THEN cast(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', DATEOCCURED) as date) ELSE cast(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', DATEADD(month, 1, DATEOCCURED)) as date) END AS Accounting_Period, PersonName, PersonCode, PersonStatus, Property, PropertyCode, Market, OP, DepositNum, CashAcct, AMOUNT, Reference, CheckNum, Notes, ModuleCreatedBy, CreatedBy, CreatedDate, ModifiedBy, ModifiedDate FROM YARDI_DBO.TRANSRECEIPT;
